verdict.rationale: A cloud platform could plausibly ship AI-generated insights over customer data, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of this. The only AI mention is Azure Copilot generating Terraform configurations, which is code generation, not insights from data. Cost Management offers user-built filters and multidimensional analysis, which is analytics, not AI-generated suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
